audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was generic and named no LeBlanc spike. Her real level 6 spike is Mimic doubling a basic spell on a 45s cooldown at rank 1, dropping to 25s at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built around Distortion and never mentions the two interactions that actually decide the lane. (a) Ethereal Chains only roots if the shackle survives 1.5 seconds — Justice Punch or simply walking out of range breaks it, and Shield of Durand's charge slow guarantees the root instead. (b) Mirror Image spawns a damage-free clone at 40% health, so an 18-second taunt or a 180-second R spent on the copy is the fight.
audit.why: Riot E text: 'If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them.' Riot passive text: 'she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage.' Galio W text: 'charges a defensive stance, moving slowly.'
